description: Fuel system module interface data for the Halcyra HC-4 and HC-2. Invented aircraft. Not for flight operations. Identifiers are invented, not registrations.

fields.interfaceVersion: Version of this interface (semantic versioning: major.minor.patch). A change of major means a field changed meaning or was removed.
fields.fuelType: The fuel the module is set up for.
fields.fuelDensityKgPerL: Fuel density the module uses to turn litres into kilograms, in kg/L, stated to 0.01 kg/L.
fields.types: Per aircraft type: fuelLeverArmM is the lever arm of the fuel mass in m aft of the datum, rounded to 0.001 m, valid for every fuel quantity; usableCapacityL is the usable fuel capacity in whole litres.
fields.aircraft: Per aircraft of the fleet: type; usableFuelL is the usable fuel quantity on board as last reported by the module, in whole litres, rounded down; fuelMassKg is usableFuelL times fuelDensityKgPerL, rounded to 0.1 kg; reportedAtUtc is the report time: the date and time in UTC of the measurement that the report is based on (ISO 8601, to the second).
